# Files that still carry Turkish, with the number of lines each carries.
#
# The tree is written in English. These files are the unfinished part of the
# translation, recorded so the `tree-is-english` gate can ratchet instead of
# failing on every commit.
#
# The numbers only go DOWN. Translating lines lowers a count; a file that
# reaches zero has its line deleted. The gate fails if a count goes up, if a
# file not listed here gains Turkish, and also if a count is higher than what
# is actually in the file, so progress cannot go unrecorded.
#
# Turkish is allowed in exactly two places, neither of which is listed here:
# README.tr.md, and the word "Türkçe" as the label on the link to it.
#
# Format: <path>\t<remaining Turkish lines>
# Recorded: 2026-08-24. 347 files, 5742 lines.
